name: Terry Call
residence: Cody area, Park County (Powell Tribune, Feb. 3, 2025, described him as a longtime Cody-area resident)
occupation: Park County assessor (appointed interim assessor in February 2025; elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Park County assessor (appointed February 2025; elected 2026). The Powell Tribune reported that he had served as first deputy assessor for 14 years under Assessor Pat Meyer.
background: Terry Call is the Park County assessor. The county's official assessor page lists him in that office. The Powell Tribune reported in February 2025 that after Assessor Pat Meyer retired at the end of December 2024, Carbon County District Court Judge Dawnessa Snyder appointed Call, then the first deputy assessor, as interim assessor through 2026, and that Call is a Republican and longtime Cody-area resident who had worked under Meyer for 14 years. He was unopposed in the November 3, 2026, general election.
